svg.title: First read of two back-to-back frames
svg.desc: Frame 1 (payload length 1500, 1508 bytes total) followed by Frame 2 (payload length 2000, 2008 bytes total). Read 1 returns the first 2048 bytes: all of Frame 1 and the first 540 bytes of Frame 2.

g.text: all of Frame 1 + first 540 bytes of Frame 2
